Container.Name: Valheim-broccoli
Container.Overview:
A dedicated server for Valheim, with crossplay, world modifiers, and optional BepInEx and Thunderstore mods.
Set SERVER_PASSWORD before you start the server.
Forward UDP ports 2456 and 2457 on your router. Valheim uses PORT and PORT + 1. If you change the ports, also change PORT.
The server files are installed on first start. After that, they are only updated if UPDATE_ON_START is true.
Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.
Container.Requires: 4 CPU cores at 2.8 GHz, 2 GB RAM (more than 4 GB recommended), 2 GB storage.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: valheim iron gate dedicated server steam bepinex thunderstore crossplay

Config.Name: Game Port 1
Config.Description: UDP game port. Forward it on your router. Must be the same as PORT.

Config.Name: Game Port 2
Config.Description: UDP query port. Forward it on your router. Must be PORT + 1.

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: Valheim server files.

Config.Name: Server Saves
Config.Description: Worlds and backups.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name of the server in the server list.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Required. Password to join. Use at least 5 characters, and do not include the server name.

Config.Name: World Name
Config.Description: Name of the world. If no world has this name, a new world is made.

Config.Name: Public
Config.Description: Show the server in the server list. If false, players join with the Join IP button.

Config.Name: Crossplay Enabled
Config.Description: Use the crossplay backend (PlayFab) so players on all platforms can join.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players. Vanilla Valheim allows 10. Other values install BepInEx and the MaxPlayerCount mod.

Config.Name: Server Preset
Config.Description: World modifier preset: Normal, Casual, Easy, Hard, Hardcore, Immersive, or Hammer. It replaces earlier modifiers.

Config.Name: Modifier: Combat
Config.Description: veryeasy, easy, hard, or veryhard. Leave empty for the preset value.

Config.Name: Modifier: Death Penalty
Config.Description: casual, veryeasy, easy, hard, or hardcore. Leave empty for the preset value.

Config.Name: Modifier: Resources
Config.Description: muchless, less, more, muchmore, or most. Leave empty for the preset value.

Config.Name: Modifier: Raids
Config.Description: none, muchless, less, more, or muchmore. Leave empty for the preset value.

Config.Name: Modifier: Portals
Config.Description: casual, hard, or veryhard. Leave empty for the preset value.

Config.Name: No Map
Config.Description: Disable the map (true or false).

Config.Name: Player Events
Config.Description: Base raid events on players instead of the world (true or false).

Config.Name: Passive Mobs
Config.Description: Make mobs passive (true or false).

Config.Name: No Build Cost
Config.Description: Disable building costs (true or false).

Config.Name: Fire Hazards
Config.Description: Let fire spread and set fire to what it touches (true or false).

Config.Name: Save Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between world saves.

Config.Name: Keep Backups
Config.Description: Number of automatic backups to keep.

Config.Name: Backups Short
Config.Description: Seconds before the first automatic backup.

Config.Name: Backups Long
Config.Description: Seconds between the later automatic backups.

Config.Name: BepInEx Enabled
Config.Description: Enable BepInEx modding (true or false).

Config.Name: BepInExPack Version
Config.Description: BepInExPack_Valheim version to install when BepInEx is needed.

Config.Name: Mods
Config.Description: Comma-separated Thunderstore dependency strings, for example Azumatt-AAA_Crafting-2.1.6. If set, BepInEx is enabled.

Config.Name: Beta Branch
Config.Description: Steam branch to install, for example default_old. Use public for the stable branch.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Update the server with SteamCMD on each start (true or false). The server is always installed on first start.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Game port the server listens on. The server also uses PORT + 1. Must be the same as Game Port 1.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions.
